title: What Are the Rules for Watching Dolphins From a Boat in Madeira?
description: Madeira law bans boats from approaching dolphins closer than 50 m, allows 10 minutes per boat and 40 in total, and bans chasing. The 2013 rules, explained.
heroAlt: Small group of dolphins surfacing at a respectful distance from a private boat off Madeira
keywords: rules for watching dolphins in Madeira
how close can a boat get to dolphins in Madeira
can you swim with dolphins in Madeira
